result:
Round 226 (CALM-1a) is implemented with no STOP. Pressing `?` or the new footer button opens a searchable keyboard-shortcut sheet over Studio, and the permanent 19-key shortcut line is gone. Typecheck, lint and the 320 covering tests pass, and the code-reviewer subagent ran; I fixed its findings. The full suite, `npm run verify` and `npm run build` were not run; they belong to the root gate.

**What changed** (exactly 4 modified + 5 new files, HEAD still `80fbb3b`, frozen and root hashes still match):
- **Shortcut list:** `app/lib/arrangement/shortcuts.ts` holds all 43 rows in 8 groups, plus search, and is the one source for the sheet.
- **Sheet:** `ArrangementShortcutSheet.tsx` is built on the existing `Modal`. It opens with focus in the search field, keeps Tab inside, and on close returns focus to whatever was focused before. It falls back to the footer button when that was nothing.
- **`?` key** in `StudioWorkspace.tsx`: it is ignored in text fields, while Export or a menu is open, during a drag, with Ctrl/Alt/Meta, and on auto-repeat. While the sheet is open, all Studio keys do nothing.
- **Footer:** the shortcut line is replaced by one row: the lane-move hint, else the selected-clip line, else the blank reserve, with the Shortcuts button on the right.
- Also: the new strings, WSU1 and the first UC12 assertion, new tests SC1–SC3 and SS1–SS10, and implementation doc 177.

**Checks:**
- **Tests:** 25 files, 320 tests green. The slowest is 3.9 s against a 20 s limit; SS2 is 1.85 s under load, so I gave the new SS file the same 20 s timeout its sibling suites use.
- **Mutants:** MU-a…MU-f each turn their target test red. Three more (MU-g, MU-h, MU-i) prove the tests added after the review.
- **Browser, both viewports (1440×900 and 1280×720):**
  - The footer shrinks from 69 to 49 px, and the timeline gains 20 px (516 and 406 px tall).
  - The new footer row is 16 px.
  - Footer button contrast is 6.68:1 at rest and 14.78:1 on hover.
  - ⌘ and ⌥ render with real glyphs, so the ⌘/⌥ subline shipped.
  - The widest row (`fit`) is not truncated, and there is no horizontal overflow.
  - Esc, the backdrop and Space on Close all close the sheet, and focus comes back correctly.
  - The other keyboard layouts open the sheet; a plain `/` does not.
  - A held `?` opens it once.
  - There were no page errors.

**Fixes I added beyond the task text:**
- Esc is marked as handled while the sheet is open, so it cannot also return an expanded floating video.
- Space on the sheet's Close button now works. Studio's own keyup handler, outside my grant, was cancelling it.
- Repeated `?` presses no longer type "????" into the search field.
- Focus falls back to the footer button if returning it to the original control fails.
- The title uses `font-medium`: the Studio theme test (TH10) rejected `font-semibold`.

**Decisions for B:**
- Group headings are 12 px (`text-xs`) instead of the 11 px label style, because C-A11Y requires all text to be at least 12 px.
- UC12 needed one extra import line beyond its first assertion, and its title still says "shortcut hint" because the title is frozen.
- Two source citations in the task table were wrong: `lane-lock` is `ArrangementClip.tsx` l.491 (not StudioWorkspace), and `overview-scroll` and `waveform-zoom` are now confirmed in source. No row was added or dropped.

**Reviewer suggestions (proposals only, nothing done):**
1. A single "a blocking dialog is open" flag for Export and the sheet, read by both key handlers. That would remove the sheet's Space workaround.
2. A shared focus hook for the two dialogs.
3. `studio.$productId.tsx` has its own unguarded `?`/Esc handler. It is not mounted with this workspace today; it is protected and I did not touch it.

**Known gaps for C:**
- The C-BBOX dump and C-ROWS (performing every shortcut once in the real Studio) were not run by me.
- Most of the "`?` does not open" cases were checked only in jsdom; in the browser I checked the library search.
- Esc with the floating video expanded and the sheet open is tested only in jsdom. I proposed a browser sub-row: the sheet should close and the video stay expanded.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-226.md`; logs, mutants, browser evidence and end hashes are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-226/`.
